title: Gerund, Infinitive, Conditional — Level 6 — Read the notice and messages

items.prompt: Library rules: Which activity is NOT allowed in the library?

stimulus.text: School Library Rules: Eating and drinking are not allowed. Please avoid talking loudly. Students may borrow two books and must finish reading them within seven days.

items.reteach: Kalimat "Eating and drinking are not allowed" melarang makan dan minum.

items.prompt: Library rules: How long can students keep a borrowed book?

stimulus.text: School Library Rules: Eating and drinking are not allowed. Please avoid talking loudly. Students may borrow two books and must finish reading them within seven days.

items.reteach: Teks: "must finish reading them within seven days".

items.prompt: Library rules: The word "avoid" in the notice is closest in meaning to …

stimulus.text: School Library Rules: Eating and drinking are not allowed. Please avoid talking loudly. Students may borrow two books and must finish reading them within seven days.

items.reteach: Avoid talking loudly = berusaha tidak berbicara keras.

items.prompt: Raka's message: What will happen if the weather is good on Sunday?

stimulus.text: Hi Dimas, if the weather is good on Sunday, we will cycle to Kenjeran Beach. If I had a bigger bag, I would bring my kite too. Let me know if you want to join! - Raka

visual.text: Raka will cycle to Kenjeran Beach.

choices.say: Raka will cycle to Kenjeran Beach.

visual.text: Raka will fly a kite at home.

choices.say: Raka will fly a kite at home.

visual.text: Raka will buy a bigger bag.

choices.say: Raka will buy a bigger bag.

visual.text: Raka will stay at Dimas's house.

choices.say: Raka will stay at Dimas's house.

items.reteach: Kalimat type 1: if the weather is good, we will cycle to Kenjeran Beach.

items.prompt: Raka's message: Why won't Raka bring his kite?

stimulus.text: Hi Dimas, if the weather is good on Sunday, we will cycle to Kenjeran Beach. If I had a bigger bag, I would bring my kite too. Let me know if you want to join! - Raka

visual.text: He does not have a kite.

choices.say: He does not have a kite.

items.reteach: "If I had a bigger bag" (type 2) berarti kenyataannya tasnya tidak cukup besar.

items.prompt: Raka's message: What is the purpose of the message?

stimulus.text: Hi Dimas, if the weather is good on Sunday, we will cycle to Kenjeran Beach. If I had a bigger bag, I would bring my kite too. Let me know if you want to join! - Raka

visual.text: to invite Dimas to go cycling

choices.say: to invite Dimas to go cycling

visual.text: to ask Dimas to buy a kite

choices.say: to ask Dimas to buy a kite

visual.text: to tell Dimas about the weather

choices.say: to tell Dimas about the weather

items.reteach: Kalimat "Let me know if you want to join!" menunjukkan ajakan.

items.prompt: Diary: Why did the writer miss the train?

stimulus.text: Last Saturday I missed the train to Malang. If I had set my alarm, I wouldn't have overslept. I wish I had packed my bag the night before. Next time I will be ready.

items.reteach: "I wouldn't have overslept" menunjukkan kenyataannya penulis kesiangan.

items.prompt: Diary: What does the writer regret?

stimulus.text: Last Saturday I missed the train to Malang. If I had set my alarm, I wouldn't have overslept. I wish I had packed my bag the night before. Next time I will be ready.

visual.text: not packing the bag the night before

choices.say: not packing the bag the night before

items.reteach: I wish I had packed = penyesalan karena tidak menyiapkan tas.

items.prompt: Diary: What can we infer about the writer's alarm that night?

stimulus.text: Last Saturday I missed the train to Malang. If I had set my alarm, I wouldn't have overslept. I wish I had packed my bag the night before. Next time I will be ready.

visual.text: It was set for the wrong day.

choices.say: It was set for the wrong day.

items.reteach: "If I had set my alarm" (type 3) berarti kenyataannya alarm tidak dipasang.

items.prompt: English tips: Which tip is given in the text?

stimulus.text: Tips for Learning English: Keep practising every day. Try watching films with English subtitles. Avoid translating every word. Don't be afraid of making mistakes; they help you learn.

items.reteach: Teks menyarankan "Try watching films with English subtitles".

visual.text: because it comes after the preposition "of"
